messages.message: Simulation
Simulation (for experts)
Simulation interval
Minutes; how many match minutes should be simulated per execution. 150 means that the entire match is calculated at once.
Max. matches per minute
Maximum number of matches simulated per calculation run. On slow servers, this value should be reduced to avoid major calculation delays.
No user-submitted lineup
Consequence if a user has not submitted a lineup for the match.
No lineup for either team
Consequence if neither team in a match has a set lineup.
Generate lineup through the system
Award match as 0:0
Award match 3:0 to the opposing team
The system should automatically generate a lineup if the team has no manager.
Attacking tactics for computer lineups
Attacking level in percent for lineups generated by the system.
Allow ticket sales for friendly matches as well. This enables clubs to generate income from friendlies.
Simulation strategy
Class name of a custom match calculation.
Goalkeeper influence
in percent; influence of the goalkeeper's strength on shots.
Shot frequency
in percent; 100% means normal frequency.
Card frequency after fouls
in percent; 100% means normal frequency.
Injury frequency
in percent; 100% means normal frequency.
Strength weighting
in percent; share of the player attribute strength in the player's overall strength.
Technique weighting
in percent; share of the player attribute technique in the player's overall strength.
Stamina weighting
in percent; share of the player attribute stamina in the player's overall strength.
Fitness weighting
in percent; share of the player attribute fitness in the player's overall strength.
Satisfaction weighting
in percent; share of the player attribute satisfaction in the player's overall strength.
Shot power: defenders
in percent of the player's overall strength.
Shot power: midfielders
in percent of the player's overall strength.
Shot power: strikers
in percent of the player's overall strength.
Minimum playing minutes for strength effects
in minutes; the number of minutes after which a player is marked as "played". Affects satisfaction and stamina.
Suspension after number of yellow cards

Number of yellow cards after which a player is suspended for one match. 0 means never suspend. The suspension is repeated after every multiple (e.g. if value=5, suspension after 5, 10, 15, ... cards).
Allow users to change tactics during a live match simulation.
Permitted live tactical changes
How often a user may change the attacking tactics and other options during a match. 0 means not at all.
Players tire (lose fitness) when they play. The amount depends on minutes played, age, stamina and attacking level.
Stamina change
How many points the player gains or loses when they play or do not play.
Satisfaction change
How many points the player gains or loses when they play or do not play.
Fitness gain when not playing
How many points the player gains if they did not play.
Strength reduction in secondary position
in percent; reduction for players playing in their secondary position.
Strength reduction out of position
in percent; reduction for players playing in neither their main nor secondary position.
Home advantage
Number of strength points gained by home-team players when the stadium is sold out. 0 means no home advantage.
Max. matches injured
Maximum number of matches a player can miss through injury. Note that the probability of a player being unavailable for more than 7 matches is only 1%.
Max. matches suspended
Maximum number of matches for which a player is suspended due to a red card.
Players can also be injured in friendly matches and then miss several matches.
Simulation Observers
Comma-separated list of PHP classes that implement the ISimulationObserver interface and should be active in match simulation.
Simulator Observers
Comma-separated list of PHP classes that implement the ISimulatorObserver interface and should be active in match simulation.
Generate a new lineup if the user has fielded fewer than 11 players (e.g. because a player was injured in the meantime).
Players also lose fitness and can build stamina through friendly matches.
Player strength in computer lineups
in percent; less than 100% means that players selected by the system are weakened.
Players also change fitness, stamina and satisfaction in national-team matches.
